# Changelog

<!-- Generated by Docs/Update-ApiReference.ps1 from Docs/api-reference.json. Edit the release notes there. -->

Every release of the FluentLocalizer packages, newest first. The [WebUI changelog](https://noyzone99.github.io/FluentLocalizer/changelog) shows the same notes with links to the API reference of each version.

## Core 1.2.0 (2026-11-23)

Packages: `FluentLocalizer`, `FluentLocalizer.Extensions.DependencyInjection`

Catalog-aware plurals and ordinals, more reliable translation resolution, and updated examples and documentation.

### Added

- The optional `ITranslationStoreWithCulture` contract lets stores supply ICU plural and ordinal rules from the catalog culture. Number and date formats follow the requested culture. See [Culture selection](https://noyzone99.github.io/FluentLocalizer/docs/core/v1/culture#fallback).

### Changed

- ICU formatters are reused with a bounded lifetime to reduce repeated parsing.

### Fixed

- Exception factories propagate their errors and run once for each failure. Concurrent option reference changes are read safely. Identifier casing handles combining characters and supplementary letters, and fallback tokens preserve literal keys.
- The DI quick start includes the logging prerequisite for a standalone console. The Worker registers its disposable store through a container-owned factory.
- The Playground generates precise C# decimal literals. The API reference keeps the selected release in the URL, redirects retain links to historical versions, and the documentation sidebar releases its listeners when navigating away. Prerelease comparisons follow SemVer precedence.

<details><summary>Public API changes (1)</summary>

- Added: `ITranslationStoreWithCulture`

</details>

## JSON store 1.3.0 (2026-11-23)

Packages: `FluentLocalizer.Store.Json`

Catalog-culture reporting, atomic HTTP refresh, cancellable response reads and consistent JSON lookup.

### Added

- The JSON stores report the selected catalog culture through `ITranslationStoreWithCulture`. This release depends on FluentLocalizer 1.2.0.

### Changed

- The embedded candidate cache is bounded. The legacy `JsonStore` wrapper forwards `MaxDocumentBytes` to the selected store.

### Fixed

- HTTP refresh coordinates first loads of new cultures with the catalog update. Cancellation stops reads of catalogs and manifests even when a document size limit is configured.
- Catalogs must have a JSON object at the root. A rejected HTTP refresh keeps the previous catalog, and an in-flight lookup cannot put an invalidated base-store result back in the cache.
- Filesystem reload handles directory events and consults fallback only after looking for the requested key. HTTP synchronous lookup applies the same strict fallback check as asynchronous lookup.
- Namespace files stay distinct from combined culture catalogs. Reverse names and dotted embedded namespaces resolve correctly, and regional lookups respect neutral culture mappings.
- The Blazor sample preloads base culture files and downloads its namespace bundle on first use.

<details><summary>Public API changes (4)</summary>

- Changed: `JsonFileStore` — Reports the selected catalog culture through ITranslationStoreWithCulture and invalidates catalogs when watched directories change.
- Changed: `EmbeddedJsonStore` — Reports the selected catalog culture through ITranslationStoreWithCulture. Supports dotted namespaces and limits its candidate cache.
- Changed: `HttpJsonStore` — Reports the selected catalog culture through ITranslationStoreWithCulture. Coordinates first culture loads with refresh and respects cancellation during catalog and manifest reads.
- Changed: `JsonStore` — Forwards MaxDocumentBytes and exposes the selected store's catalog culture through ITranslationStoreWithCulture.

</details>

## Core 1.1.0 (2026-11-16)

Packages: `FluentLocalizer`, `FluentLocalizer.Extensions.DependencyInjection`

Native .NET 11 support with unchanged public APIs and continued support for earlier targets.

### Added

- A native `net11.0` target for FluentLocalizer and its dependency injection package, alongside `netstandard2.0`, `net8.0` and `net10.0`.

### Changed

- The dependency injection package uses Microsoft.Extensions 11.0.0 on .NET 11 and 10.0.15 on earlier targets, preserving .NET 8 and .NET Framework compatibility. Public APIs and translation behavior are unchanged.
- The repository, samples, website and release workflows use the .NET 11 SDK. Website integration tests run on both .NET 10 and .NET 11. Removed the obsolete Blazor debugging proxy configuration and guarded browser JavaScript calls so optional browser features cannot prevent rendering.

### Fixed

- The website homepage shows each package's release version instead of displaying the Core version for every package. Preserved the inherited DI scope factory during trimming so the playground opens in optimized WebAssembly builds.

No public API changes in this version.

## JSON store 1.2.0 (2026-11-16)

Packages: `FluentLocalizer.Store.Json`

Native .NET 11 support and refreshed dependencies, with unchanged JSON store APIs and behavior.

### Added

- A native `net11.0` target alongside `netstandard2.0`, `net8.0` and `net10.0`.

### Changed

- Updated the Core dependency to FluentLocalizer 1.1.0 and System.Text.Json for .NET Standard 2.0 to 10.0.15. Modern .NET targets keep using their runtime's JSON implementation.

No public API changes in this version.

## JSON store 1.1.0 (2026-10-12)

Packages: `FluentLocalizer.Store.Json`

Namespace files, on-demand loading and lower memory use for EmbeddedJsonStore.

### Added

- `EmbeddedJsonStore` reads namespace files such as `it.common.json`, like the file and HTTP stores, so an embedded catalog can be split by page or feature. See [Namespaces](https://noyzone99.github.io/FluentLocalizer/docs/store-json/v1#namespaces).
- `EmbeddedJsonStoreOptions.LoadOnDemand` parses each embedded file on the first lookup that needs it, so cultures that are never requested stay out of memory. See [EmbeddedJsonStore](https://noyzone99.github.io/FluentLocalizer/docs/store-json/v1/embedded).

### Changed

- `EmbeddedJsonStore` parses UTF-8 resources straight from the resource stream instead of reading them into a string first, allocating about a quarter of the memory while loading, and caches the files to search for each culture and namespace.
- Nested-key lookups in every JSON store walk the key without allocating its segments.

### Fixed

- Embedded files named like `it.common.json` were all stored under `common.json`, so files of different cultures replaced each other. Each now keeps its culture in its name; the previous name still works as a file mapping when no other file uses it.
- With a manifest, `HttpJsonStore.LoadAsync` also preloads listed neutral-culture catalogs so synchronous lookups use the same neutral fallback as asynchronous lookups.

<details><summary>Public API changes (2)</summary>

- Added: `EmbeddedJsonStoreOptions.bool LoadOnDemand { get; set; }`
- Changed: `EmbeddedJsonStore` — Reads namespace files such as it-IT.common.json, which earlier versions keyed by their last segment, common.json, so the files of different cultures replaced each other. A key with a namespace is looked for in its namespace file before the culture file. FileMappings can still use the last segment when no other file has that name.

</details>

## Core 0.1.0-alpha (2026-09-30)

Packages: `FluentLocalizer`, `FluentLocalizer.Extensions.DependencyInjection`

Breaking namespace changes, mutable translation options and corrected dependency injection registration.

### Changed

- Breaking: the core types moved from `FluentLocalizer.Core` to `FluentLocalizer`, and the logging types from `FluentLocalizer.Core.Logging` to `FluentLocalizer.Logging`. See [Upgrading from 0.0.1](https://noyzone99.github.io/FluentLocalizer/docs/core/v1/migration#namespaces).
- `TranslationOptions` properties have `set` accessors instead of `init`, so they can be configured in a dependency injection callback. See [TranslationOptions](https://noyzone99.github.io/FluentLocalizer/docs/core/v1/migration#options).

### Fixed

- `AddFluentLocalizer(services, options)` registers the options object it receives, and both overloads validate their arguments against `null`. See [Dependency injection](https://noyzone99.github.io/FluentLocalizer/docs/core/v1/migration#injection).
- `WithStore(store)` no longer registers the store twice.

## JSON store 0.1.0-alpha (2026-09-30)

Packages: `FluentLocalizer.Store.Json`

Dedicated JSON stores with shared settings, lazy loading, caching and HTTP refresh; the original JSON store was deprecated.

### Added

- [JsonFileStore](https://noyzone99.github.io/FluentLocalizer/docs/store-json/v1/file), [EmbeddedJsonStore](https://noyzone99.github.io/FluentLocalizer/docs/store-json/v1/embedded) and [HttpJsonStore](https://noyzone99.github.io/FluentLocalizer/docs/store-json/v1/http), each with its own options class.
- `JsonStoreSettings`, the settings shared by every JSON store, including the `MaxDocumentBytes` size limit. See [Settings](https://noyzone99.github.io/FluentLocalizer/docs/store-json/v1#settings).
- Optional namespace files that split a catalog by feature. See [Namespaces](https://noyzone99.github.io/FluentLocalizer/docs/store-json/v1#namespaces).

### Changed

- The HTTP store, previously in the separate `FluentLocalizer.Store.Http` package, is now part of this package. See [Moving from FluentLocalizer.Store.Http](https://noyzone99.github.io/FluentLocalizer/docs/store-json/v1/migration#from-http).

### Deprecated

- `JsonStore`, `JsonStoreOptions` and `JsonStoreLocation`. `JsonStore` now forwards every lookup to a `JsonFileStore` or an `EmbeddedJsonStore`. See [Deprecated APIs](https://noyzone99.github.io/FluentLocalizer/docs/store-json/v1/migration#deprecated).

<details><summary>Public API changes (12)</summary>

- Added: `JsonStoreSettings`
- Added: `JsonFileStoreOptions`
- Added: `EmbeddedJsonStoreOptions`
- Added: `HttpJsonStoreOptions`
- Added: `JsonTranslationStoreBase`
- Added: `JsonFileStore`
- Added: `EmbeddedJsonStore`
- Added: `HttpJsonStore`
- Changed: `JsonStore` — Reimplemented as a compatibility wrapper over JsonFileStore or EmbeddedJsonStore and marked obsolete. Uses dedicated-store loading and validation; filesystem mode is rejected in browsers.
- Changed: `JsonStoreOptions` — Became sealed, inherited JsonStoreSettings and was marked obsolete. ThrowOnError was replaced by inherited ThrowOnMissingStore; FallbackCulture and FileMappings moved to the base class, which also adds MaxDocumentBytes.
- Deprecated: `JsonStore`
- Deprecated: `JsonStoreOptions`

</details>

## Core 0.0.1 (2026-07-30)

Packages: `FluentLocalizer`, `FluentLocalizer.Extensions.DependencyInjection`

First published release of the core and dependency injection packages.

### Added

- `ITranslator`, `Translator` and the fluent `TranslationBuilder`: arguments, plurals, gender, letter case and per-request cultures. See [Translation requests](https://noyzone99.github.io/FluentLocalizer/docs/core/v1/requests).
- ICU message templates, formatted with the MessageFormat library, with `plural` and `select` blocks. See [Templates](https://noyzone99.github.io/FluentLocalizer/docs/core/v1/templates).
- `TranslationOptions` policies for missing keys and formatting errors, and `TranslationException`. See [Errors and missing translations](https://noyzone99.github.io/FluentLocalizer/docs/core/v1/errors).
- `ITranslationLogger` and `TranslationLogLevel` for translation events. See [Logging](https://noyzone99.github.io/FluentLocalizer/docs/core/v1/logging).
- `ITranslationStore`, the contract implemented by every store. See [Custom stores](https://noyzone99.github.io/FluentLocalizer/docs/core/v1/stores/custom).
- `AddFluentLocalizer()` and `FluentLocalizerBuilder` for Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection. See [Dependency injection](https://noyzone99.github.io/FluentLocalizer/docs/core/v1/dependency-injection).

First release of these packages: every public API is new.
